chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, from Sa'd b. 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. 'Isa and Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab, from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, who said: I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him)
saying: No one from my devotees visits me recognizing my right except that I will intercede for him on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.زيارة: Visitation (ziyara) — pilgrimage to an Imam's shrine
key_terms.شفاعة: Intercession — the Imam's intervention on behalf of believers on Judgment Day
key_terms.عارفاً بحقه: Recognizing his right — acknowledging his divinely appointed Imamate

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida promise to those who visit his shrine?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) said: 'No one from my devotees visits me recognizing my right except that I will intercede for him on the Day of Resurrection.' This hadith, transmitted through the same chain as the previous one, establishes the personal guarantee of intercession by Imam al-Rida for those who visit his shrine with true knowledge of his divinely appointed Imamate.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa and Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti. He said: I heard al-Rida (as) say:
Not one of my supporters visits me, knowing my right, except that I will intercede for him on the Day of Resurrection.
